eps.d: A young schoolgirl called Debbie wonders into an old curiosity shop. There, she stumbles on a game called "Wonders in Letterland", which, to her surprise, comes alive. Befriending the game's inhabitants, Debbie soon learns of the evil witch T-Bag, and soon finds herself charged with locating a series of missing letters....

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of B
eps.d: Debbie must learn the name of a guard in order to advance to the next stage of her quest...

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of S
eps.d: Debbie befriends a friendly skipper called McKipper, who nails himself a treasured find in the form of a golden S, only to throw it back into the sea. Debbie and McSkipper embark on a search beneath the waves and encounter T-Bag and Seraphina the Seasprite...

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of I
eps.d: Debbie teams up with archaeologist Indiana Inkspot to search fro the golden treasure of the inkers as well as the next missing letter

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of P
eps.d: Debbie and Polar Pete are presented with a problem when T-Bag locks the letter P deep within an icy prison

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of R
eps.d: Debbie embarks on a treasure hunt when her letters are taken by the pirate Rascally Roger...

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of V
eps.d: Debbie and T-Shirt arrive in the land of V, where they come face to face with a vampire, and T-Shirt feels the power of the sleeping violets. T-Bag takes action and disguises herself as T-Shirt in a bid to seize Debbie's letters...

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of O
eps.d: Debbie helps the elderly Fife O'Clock get his clock working again...

eps.t: Debbie in the Land of E
eps.d: T-Bag, Debbie and T-Shirt arrive in the final zone of the Letterland game, where they must make a melancholy emperor laugh in order to attain his gold necklace..
Debbie and T-Shirt race back to the beginning of the game, but find that T-Bag has a surprise up her sleeve that puts things in her favor. Can Debbie unravel the secret of the chest?

Both Debbie and T-Shirt find themselves once again crossing paths with T-Bag, who has now taken residence in a story book. To ensure she cannot be destroyed, T-Bag brings a halt to time. Debbie must now embark on a quest to locate the silver numbers and restore the town clock to working order in order for all the stories in the book to end, and bring about T-Bag's defeat...
Debbie befriends a dashing Prince searching for his ideal Princess. T-Bag discovers the silver shoes the Prince has prepared for his bride contain silver numbers and plots to attain them...
As Debbie is aided by Bunty Badshot in searching for the number three, T-Bag targets Bunty's reclusive brother Ben, whose cricket bats carry the vital number

Debbie and junk collector Scrap Harry conjure forth a magic genie and attempt a wish for the number four, but the ancient genie is far too old to do magic. T-Bag manipulates Harry and the Genie into delivering Debbie into her clutches...

Debbie is cohered into having her hair cut by Ali Barber, a down-on-his-luck barber in desperate need of customers. As payment for the trim, he takes all of the silver numbers Debbie has collected thus far, which are in turn taken by a powerful Sultan. Meanwhile, T-Bag runs into hair problems all of her own and takes her fury out on The Sultan...
When Debbie's Numbers are seized by good-natured Highwayman Dick Gherkin, T-Bag sets about preparing a trap for the theif..

Debbie is mistaken for a singer by radio pirate jockey Long John Sylvia and her assistant Jack and is recruited to sing for their radio station. The station soon catches the attention of T-Bag, who tries out her own voice on the airwaves, with disastrous results...
Debbie manipulates T-Bag into sending her and astrologist Professor Pockets to the moon, where they encounter aliens and musical rocks all en route to discovering the silver number eight....

When T-Bag strips T-Shirt of his powers, it falls to traveling entertaining Charlie Chuckles to teach him how to do a few fun magic tricks. Debbie encounters a depressed King who carries the number nine as a lucky charm. T-Bag demands to be entertained by the King and in desperation, the King asks Charlie Chuckles for help, but he refuses, insisting the King has not paid for any show before, but…

T-Bag disguises herself and tricks Debbie into giving her the silver numbers. With the numbers finally in her possesion, T-Bag sets about plotting their destruction. With T-Shirt her only hope, can Debbie locate the remainder of the missing numbers in time?

T-Bag takes up residence in a music box, using a new High-T plant to enhance her powers. When the cheerful Major Happy decides to play her a special tune using his Glockenspiel, T-Bag is nearly destroyed. in anger, she steals the Glockenspiel and scatters it's golden bells throughout the land.

Debbie's quest takes her to an unbearably hot desert, where she befriends water merchant Omar Caraffe, whose bird cage carries one of the golden bells. T-Bag schemes to take the bell and makes use of T-Shirt's ventriloquism to trick Omar into letting his guard down. Meanwhile, Debbie discovers a bottle containing a powerful genie...

Debbie discovers that the crown of the soon-to-be-coronated Prince Ivan carries a golden bell...worse still, she discovers Ivan is the exact double of T-Shirt. T-Bag mistakes the obnoxious Ivan for T-Shirt and takes him back to the T-Room, whilst the real T-Shirt is manipulated by the evil Count Boris as part of his nefarious scheme to take over his kingdom via an abdication, but that depends on…

Debbie is captured by Pirate Black Hearted Belle, who carries one of the golden bells around as an earring. Attempting to escape, Debbie ends up falling over and rendered with amnesia. Belle convinces Debbie that she is part of her pirate crew.

eps.t: Bobby Jobsworth and the Temple of Doom
eps.d: Debbie allies herself with Bobby Jobsworth, an easily frightened explorer who is on a mission of mercy. Stumbling on an ancient tomb, Bobby is manipulated by T-Bag into persuading Debbie to enter the tomb, only for T-Bag to seal her inside. Meanwhile, T-Shirt attempts to celebrate Halloween...

Debbie arrives in a Chinese world and meets Hi-Hat, a hat merchant attempting to please a Princess whose frequent mood swings prevent her from settling on a perfect piece of head wear. Seizing Debbie's golden bells for himself, Hi-Hat attaches the bells to a hat for the Princess, who takes it home.

Debbie helps the kindly King Rufus search for his dog, who finds himself being cared for by T-Shirt. Sorceress Wilma Wishbone, enraged that the King rejected her services for a dog, discovers Rufus is now befriended by Debbie and puts her under a powerful sleeping spell...

Debbie seeks out the next golden bell, only to discover it is in the clutches of the bad-tempered Max, a miller concerned by the lack of business he is making. Debbie agrres to work for Max in exchange for the golden bell as payment. T-Bag discovers that nobody has remembered her birthday...

Debbie is befriended by Nikdit, who betrays her and steals her golden bells. He presents them to his master, who is obsessed with food. T-Shirt leaves T-Bag after she strips him of his powers and meets Nikdt, and the two scheme to rob Nikdt's master....

As Debbie and T-Shirt make their way back to the beginning, T-Bag lets her anger out on Major Happy, turning him into her new T-Caddy. Escaping, Happy informs Debbie that they need the frame to place the bells on. T-Bag captures T-Shirt and seizes the bells. As T-Shirt desperately makes a bid for freedom, it appears as if T-Bag has won...will things stay forever out of tune?

T-Shirt is once again abducted by T-Bag, who has now set up shop inside a television set. Her plan this time is to transmit a hypnotic frequency over her new t.v station "Hi-TV" and brainwash the human race into singing her praises, but when her system shortens out, she seeks out advise from kindly Professor Sparkes, who informs her she needs a booster.
Holly is framed for robbery by T-Bag, whilst T-Shirt is mistaken for a mobster...

In search of the next crystal, Holly journeys to a monastery and meets Botanist Daisy Digwell, who is searching for a rare plant. T-Bag visits the monastery herself and plots a trap for Holly, and learns of a powerful Yeti patrolling the area, but what is it's secret?

JR Sudd, An advertising mogul, finds himself in a pickle when the star of his new Bubble Boy commercial comes down with the mumps. In his search for a replacement, he finds T-Shirt. Holly is also recruited as a potential star of the commercial by the JR's wife Krystal...

Holly and journalist Scoop Shuttleworth explore a vast pyramid and discover the next crystal within it, only for a menacing mummy to claim it. T-Bag finds herself seeing double when she is confronted by the Queen of the Nile...

T-Shirt celebrates Christmas in the T-Room whilst Holly has her crystals taken by the selfish and bitter Ebeneezer Scrimp. T-Nag and T-Shirt hatch a plot to obtain the crystals, only to end up convincing Scrimp that there really is a Santa Claus...

A powerful French Queen is constantly having her jewelery taken by masked robber The Scarlet Pimp. Seeking help in snaring the Pimp, she recruits T-Bag and T-Shirt and promises them a crystal as a reward. Holly is mistaken for an accomplice of the Pimp and is locked up...

Holly stows away aboard The African Queen, a cargo ship, but is soon caught by the slimy Mr. Grimes, who hates children. Meanwhile, T-Shirt inadvertently hypnotizes T-Bag, reverting her to a child-like state at the snap of a finger...

In the wild west, Doc Leaf, a traveling salesman, is trying to convince Hotel owner Dorabella to try his latest herbal remedy, but she is not impressed. Holly arrives and asks Leaf if he has seen a crystal, but Doc tricks her and swaps his identical snakeskin bag with hers. T-Shirt once again leaves T-Bag and takes a similar bag with him to the west.

Holly and T-Shirt return to Professor Sparkes lab with the crystals, unaware that he is still under T-Bag's control. T-Bag learns that the booster is finally ready, but it will take time to power up. With the booster nearly at optimum efficiency, the race is on to complete the jammer neccesary to destroy T-Bag before she is able to enslave the world with her hypnotic spell...but can Holly and…

T-Bag is summoned to the hall of the benevolent High-Tea, T-Bag's old mistress. The High-Tea nearly strips T-Bag of her powers and demands she become a part of the peaceful, tolerable T-Set, but T-Bag soon turns the tables and gains the power to exile the High-Tea and take control of the T-Set, she sets about capturing T-Shirt and Sally Simpkins, an Innocent visitor to the Curiosity Shop.
Sally finds herself in the company of a childish roman Cesar, whom she must save from an attempted coup. T-Bag offers her help in overthrowing the emperor...
Whilst investigating the museum of an orbiting spaceship, Sally is confronted by the crew, who decide to leave her on a nearby planet....

Sally arrives in a Turkish market. Deciding to quench h her thirst, she buys a bottle of lemonade from trader Karim Carmel, but inadvertently takes a bottle containing a mischievous spirit, who is transfixed by anything silver....

In the Austrian alps, scientist Wolfgang Krimper works feverishly on a cure for his aging, but ends up creating a formula that frequently switches him from an old man to a young boy. Things are worsened when T-Shirt takes a sip of the formula and regresses to a young baby. Sally's spoons are stolen and it falls to her and bar owner Hazel Knutt to get them back...

Discovering that the next spoon is attached to a trophy intended for the winner of a signing competition, T-Bag and T-Shirt attempt to apply. Meanwhile, Sally agrees to help aspiring rock musician Ricky Romero try out for the competition...

Sally is mistaken for a Romany called Rosie, who is her exact double, Rosie also happens to be Anastasia, daughter of King Leopold. T-Bag captures Rosie in a bid to get the next spoon, but ends up with a bag of beans instead....

T-Shirt tricks an art critic into thinking he has painted all of artist Vincent Van Driver's paintings, hoping he can get his hands on a Silver Spoon for T-Bag. T-Bag herself becomes paranoid over Friday The Thirteenth...

Queen Elizabeth demands to be entertained by the latest offering from playwright William Wagadagger. Exiled once again by T-Bag, T-Shirt bonds with The Queen and teaches her how to dance to pop music. With the final spoon at stake, Sally and T-Shirt agree to participate in William's play and entertain the Queen, but T-Bag is determined to prove that this time, the bad guys CAN win...

T-Bag has won. The silver spoons are in her possession and the celestial alignment is only hours away. Determined to thwart T-Bag at all costs, T-Shirt and Sally brave spiders and snakes all in a final desperate gamble to retrieve the spoons, but they find the odds stacked against them. Can anything be done to prevent T-Bag from attaining mastery over the universe?

Just when T-Shirt thinks he's rid himself of one bossy bag, another rears her head. Tabatha Bag, sister of Tallulah Bag,. manipulates kindly Captain Cockle into letting her take up residence in his lighthouse, where she promptly throws him out.

Sally travels to the wild west where a burglar stashes his loot in her bag, and in doing so, frames her for robbery. She ends up in jail. T-Bag and T-Shirt arrive in town eager to take advantage of the situation....

When Willaby, the prized dog of Lady Ruffles, goes missing, Ruffles offer a reward. With the next pearl at stake, T-Bag and T-Shirt offer their services disguised as Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson. Can Sally cream their case?
Sally's pearls are stolen by Grimble, and attaches them to a jacket made espeically for Lord Squiffington-Fop. Now Sally and T-Bag must infiltrate Squiffy's masked ball in order to retrieve them...

Sally arrives on a Royal Navy ship, where a mutiny is on the rise. T-Bag and T-Shirt offer their help in making sure the mutiny is a success, can Sally warn the captain in time and secure the next pearl?
Sally arrives at Castle McCarr in the Scottish islands, but can she uncover the secret of the Phantom Piper?
Arriving in Egypt, T-Shirt conspires with servant girl Osiris to take the next pearl, but discovers that her Prince is his exact double...

eps.t: Cedric Sackbutt's Search for a Song
eps.d: Sally enters a talent contest at Sherwood Forest,. whilst T-Bag and T-Shirt join Robyn Hood's band of merry men in a bid to take the pearls, which have been taken from Sally by the crafty Robyn..

T-Shirt is stripped of his magic by T-Bag and is sent to a fort belonging to the foreign legion, where he signs up. Sally arrives at the fort in search of the final pearl and meets gambler Rick O'Shea. Meanwhile, T-Bag gains an unlikely admirer in the form of Legionnaire Beau Legge...

Sally and T-Shirt reunite with Captain Cockle, but T-Bag is able to gain the upper hand and tricks Cockle into giving her the pearls. His spirit crushed, Cockle seemingly joins T-Bag's cause, but it is in fact a ruse and he is able to get the children into the T-Room with what they require to defeat T-Bag, but with one pearl missing, can they hope to win the game and prevent T-Bag from reigning…

T-Bag attempts to set up shop within Mount Olympus, but is cast out by Athena, the goddess of Wisdom. Allying herself once more with T-Shirt, T-Bag hatches a plan to steal the priceless rings of Olympus, guarded by Athena's handmaiden Pollyzana (or Polly for short). When the plan goes awry, Athena has no choice but to scatter the rings across time and space.

Polly arrives in the Mexican desert and meets bandit El Moustachio, who has stolen a gold ring from Barber Pedro. Vowing to get back all of Pedro's earnings in exchange for the ring, Polly tricks Mustachio into letting her join his gang...
Polly befriends Maggie McDougal, whose locket contains a clue to the whereabouts of a hidden treasure, can they find it, and the next ring, before T-Bag and the nefarious Grizzly McMoose?
Polly finds herself in the Caribbean, where her rings are stolen by prickly pirate Rum Barbara...
Granny Bag drops by and persuades T-Shirt to come trick-or-treating with her. Polly is invited to spend an evening with Igor Von Flededrmaus, a vampire...
Eager to get their hands on the next ring, T-Bag and Polly fight to convince a film Director they are the perfect fit for a role in his latest production...
Polly arrives in Victorian London, where her rings are stolen by a thief called The Weasel...
T-Bag and Polly encounter Leonardo Da Vinci and the Duke of Florence, where there is a mix-up of paintings...
Polly arrives in Merry England, where Sir Walter Pistol plots the Queen's demise...

The final leg of Polly's quest takes her into the heart of enemy territory. Seizing an opportunity to eliminate Polly and take the rings, T-Bag lures her into the maze of the minotaur. Can a repentant T-Shirt save the day, or will T-Bag acquire the power of the gods?

When reading up on her ancestor Kit Bag, T-Bag learns of her expedition to the fabled lost temple of Montezuma, and of how she mysteriously vanished hunting for the treasured sunstones. Investigating the legend, T-Bag and T-Shirt explore the vast African jungle, and meet absent-minded explorer Diggory Hunt and his daughter Penny.

In the 1920s, Gussy Milksop, heir to a vast fortune, discovers that his Aunt will cut him off if he doesn't get married. Realizing that Gussy's engagement ring carries a sunstone atop it, T-Bag decides to manipulate Gussie by disguising herself as rich heiress Daisy Pelf...

Penny arrives in Switzerland where she allies herself with Wilma Tell, a sharp witted advocate for the Chocolate Liberation Front, out to liberate all chocolate from the selfish King Guzzler, who places a price on Tell's head. When Guzzler breaks a tooth, T-Bag and T-Shirt pose as dentists, eager to search him for the next sunstone...

T-Shirt, tired of doing housework, sneaks off and befriends Tom, who desires to go fishing, but can't until he whitewashes his fence, T-Shirt helps him out and the two are able to enjoy the rest of the day off. Meanwhile, Penny's collection of sunstones are taken by conman Jeremiah Q. Goosepellet, who later attempts to scam Tom's kindly Aunt Molly, who has the next Sunstone...
Arriving in the 1960s, Penny meets rock star Ed Banger, who is the exact double of T-Shirt. T-Bag mistakes Ed for T-Shirt and it's not long before chaos ensues..

Penny is accused of robbing the Russian queen Tsnarnia, who is being manipulated by the true thief, the treacherous "royal healer" Rasputin, into marrying him. T-Bag replaces Tsnarnia on her wedding day, and attempts to trick Rasputin into "curing" an illness with his sunstone...

Penny arrives in the distant past and discovers the next sunstone is a symbol of power amongst a tribe of cavemen. When the sunstone is taken by an aggressive caveman called Thug, T-Bag challenges him to a fight, and picks T-Shirt as her champion...
T-Shirt attempts to manipulate Napoleon into giving him the next sunstone, whilst Napoleon's lieutenant Bidet plots a mutiny and recruits T-Bag to help. Can Penny warn Napoleon in time?
T-Shirt and Granny Bag sneak off on holiday and encounter a creepy castle. Penny arrives as well and it's not long before all of them come face to face with a Frankenstein monster...

T-Bag captures Diggory and demands Penny hand over all of the sunstones to spare his life. Penny gives her one in exchange for proof of her father's incarceration, T-Bag agrees and goes to collect Diggory's watch, but Penny pursues her and rescues her father.

It is nearly T-Bag's birthday, but T-Shirt would rather spend time with Granny Bag. Furious, T-Bag destroys Granny Bag's home. T-Bag is sent a golden envelope with time/space coordinates, challenging her to find the "greatest gift of all", she sets off with T-Shirt and his cousin Tow-Ling to find it....
Tow-Ling makes a wish on a magic lamp that shrinks T-Bag to a microscopic level, now the trio of T-Bag, T-Shirt and Tow-Ling must retrieve the lamp from a wealthy Sultan...
T-Bag helps mobster Bagsy Malone escape the law, but when Tow-Ling is apprehended, T-Bag must someone capture Bagsy to clear his name...
T-Bag arrives in Egypt and investigates a nearby tomb, but it's not long before she's subjected to a series of tricks that cause her to turn on T-Shirt...
T-Bag arrives in the Caribbean and meets secret agent Bermuda Shultz, and the malevolent Doctor Strangebag, who is consumed with ruling the world...
Arriving in Ancient Rome, Tow-Ling is captured and sold as a slave to Roman Senator Antonius. T-Bag disguises herself as the beautiful Cleopatra to trick Antonius into handing back Tow-Ling...
T-Bag arrives at the Vienna opera and takes the place of the Soprano, who has been captured by a masked Phantom...

Stranded in deep space, T-Bag encounters the Nibbles, tiny fluffy creatures that can consume metal. When T-Bag's saucer spacecraft is swallowed by a larger vessel commanded by Bin Bag, it becomes a race against time to prevent the Nibbles from consuming the ship...
Arriving in Hollywood, Tow-Ling gets a ;part in a major commercial. When T-Bag demands a piece of the action and auditions for a role, she finds stiff competition in the form of Hedda Hoofer Bag...

T-Bag's patience has run out and she demands to be sent home, but when T-Shirt and Tow-Ling protest, she takes command of the situation, only to crash her saucer spacecraft. When T-Shirt and Tow-Ling go missing, T-Bag sets off to find them, but will she succeed in locating them? And will it finally lead to the greatest gift of all?
